sentences.en: You look you've just returned from a safari in the savannah.
sentences.zh: 你看起来刚从非洲大草原旅行回来。

sentences.en: If you are going to the safari park, take the No.5 bus.
sentences.zh: 如果你要去野生动物园，坐5路公交车。

sentences.en: We went on safari with a hire car.
sentences.zh: 我们租了辆车去了一次非洲探险之旅。

senses.zh: 狩猎远征，游猎；长途旅行；旅游期间；外出期间
